prompt: Green trades lunch for a dinosaur book
title: Dino Book Trade
irony: Green trades his lunch to read about big hungry dinosaurs and becomes the hungriest dinosaur himself until sharing brings lunch back.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Green and Navy sit on the street curb with a lunchbox as Black waves a big dinosaur book.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green begs for the book, corrects Black's rex name, and refuses his new sandwich unread.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Black offers the dinosaur book now for Green's whole lunchbox on the street.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: Inside Gold's Diner the kids chant about the dino book around Green's lunchbox.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Green swaps his lunch for the book, then corrects Gold's order and gets an empty plate.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Starving Green roars like a tiny-armed rex while his tummy growls louder than drums.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The kids chant the dino-book hook again as Green hugs the book with an empty tummy.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Gold watches hungry Green and remembers quietly paying for Silver's soup on rainy days.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Gold decides to share his own pancakes with the hungry kids because giving comes back.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Gold sings the turned line as Green shares the book and shares Gold's pancakes with Black.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Green shares the book and pancakes on the curb with Navy and Black while Gold watches.
